title: DataEfficiency
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Efficiency inherent-and-system data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that can be processed and provide the expected levels of performance by using the appropriate amounts and types of resources in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent and System-Dependent Data Quality — Efficiency).

processingEfficiency.description: Efficiency of data processing — resource consumption relative to data volume and complexity.

storageEfficiency.description: Efficiency of data storage — ratio of useful information to total storage consumed.

indexingRequired.description: Whether data requires indexing for acceptable query/processing performance.
